{"reason": "Changed the medium/high branch action to alert-planner: it costs 35,000 versus 45,000 for the supplier switch and always arrives in time, so it dominates. v1's 34 supplier switches (1,530,000) plus 4 stockouts (600,000) caused cost 2,165,000, fitness -2.565; rows like medium/inv=2.8 and medium/inv=5.3 stock out under the supplier. New policy: ~1,225,000 cost, 0 stockouts, fitness ~-1.225.", "source": "(define (expedite-response risk-level inventory-days)
  (cond
    ((and (>= (risk-rank risk-level) (risk-rank 'high)) (< inventory-days 5))
     (list 'alert-planner 'immediate-expedite-review))
    ((>= (risk-rank risk-level) (risk-rank 'medium))
     (list 'alert-planner 'immediate-expedite-review))
    (else (list 'monitor))))"}
